name: Re-hemmed Boxer Brief (3-Pack, Mixed)
description: A mismatched trio of boxer briefs sold together at salvage markets — one plain black, one faded navy with a broken elastic band re-sewn with flat polythread, one grey with a small repair patch at the inner seam. Different brands, different wear levels, sold together because nobody sells them separately.
functionality: Basic underwear coverage with re-sewn elastics that hold through a work shift if not stretched hard.
what_it_says: Nothing — this is the foundation layer, invisible and essential, the baseline of getting through a day.
worn_by: literally anyone on the Shelf who wears underwear
manufacturer: Various — bundled mixed salvage, Ruck Market standard
story_hooks: One of the three has a small hand-drawn number inside the waistband — part of an inventory system from somewhere, or a personal marker.
The Ruck Market vendor who bundles these has an uncanny memory for faces — she remembers everyone who's ever bought from her.
